statement.description:
Emuskald needs a fence around his farm, but he is too lazy to build it himself. So he purchased a fence-building robot.

He wants the fence to be a regular polygon. The robot builds the fence along a single path, but it can only make fence corners at a single angle $ a $ .

Will the robot be able to build the fence Emuskald wants? In other words, is there a regular polygon which angles are equal to $ a $ ?
statement.formatI: The first line of input contains an integer $ t $ ( $ 0<t<180 $ ) — the number of tests. Each of the following $ t $ lines contains a single integer $ a $ ( $ 0<a<180 $ ) — the angle the robot can make corners at measured in degrees.
statement.formatO: For each test, output on a single line "YES" (without quotes), if the robot can build a fence Emuskald wants, and "NO" (without quotes), if it is impossible.
statement.hint:
In the first test case, it is impossible to build the fence, since there is no regular polygon with angle ![](https://cdn.luogu.com.cn/upload/vjudge_pic/CF270A/0bc9695322431ed07d3e711343afe48991039a08.png).

In the second test case, the fence is a regular triangle, and in the last test case — a square.

translation.description:
Emuskald 想在他的农场周围造一圈栅栏，但是他太懒了，不想自己动手。于是，他买了一个栅栏机器人。

Emuskald 想把栅栏围成正多边形。机器人每次造一个边，之后只能转动 $a^\circ$ 继续建造下一个边。

Emuskald 能造出他想要的围栏吗？也就是说，有没有一种正多边形的每一个角都为 $a^\circ$。
translation.formatI:
第一行输入一个整数 $t$，表示有 $t$ 组样例输入。

之后的 $t$ 行，每行一个整数 $a$，表示转动的角度。
translation.formatO:
如果围得出正多边形，输出 `YES`（不要定义）。否则，输出 `NO`（同上）。

（输入均不超过 `int` 类型）
translation.hint:
第一组样例中，转动角度为 $30^\circ$，围不出正多边形。

第二组转动角度为 $60^\circ$，围出三角形。

第三组转动角度为 $90^\circ$，围出正方形。

感谢 @PaulHunter 提供的翻译，[jiangyunuo](https://www.luogu.com.cn/user/1061050) 修复
